reuse.why: Puts the check in linkBankSyncAccount, the shared core every provider link goes through, and reuses its existing upgrading-account lookup instead of adding a second query; the existing withBankAccountLinkGuard precondition wrapper is not used for it.

duplication.why: The account lookup is moved ahead rather than repeated and the closed check exists once.

placement.why: The rule lands in the shared linking function so all providers get it, though the tree's precondition wrapper withBankAccountLinkGuard is the more natural home for link refusals.

scope.why: Only the reordered lookup, the new check and focused tests.

maintainability.why: Small and clear; the error string is inlined and the precondition sits inside the mutating function rather than beside the other link guard.

one_place.where: server/accounts/app.ts linkBankSyncAccount, called by all six provider link functions.
